content_sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Job Description
content_sections.text: Program Associate- II Develop and implement communication plans to promote the research and development activities of the Institute, in line with institutional goals and priorities. Identify newsworthy research outputs, interview researchers, and write press releases, news stories and feature articles for the Institute’s website and for external media. Develop content for the Institute’s R&D social media series, newsletter, annual research compendium, website, blogs and promotional materials. Assist in drafting and editing proposals, concept notes, reports, briefing notes and other documents for the Institute and its leadership, as required. Create supporting visual content, including graphics, short videos and presentations, in coordination with the design and media teams. Plan and support science communication activities, outreach events, workshops and flagship events, including the preparation of event reports and summaries. Aid internal teams in the branding and execution of their flagship events. Undertake any other responsibilities assigned by the competent authority from time to time. Program Associate - I Produce films/videos of various events. Ideate, shoot, edit and produce films for various new projects throughout the institute. Create visually engaging social media content for projects and campaigns. Film and live stream discussions, open houses, etc. Produce creative videos/films for various research initiatives.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: M.Tech./M.S./M.Phil. or equivalent in appropriate discipline; B.Tech./B.E./M.Sc./M.C.A./LLM./CA/CMA/CS/MBA/Professional qualification with 2 years experience; B.C.A./B.Sc./B.A./B.Com./B.B.A./LLB. with 6 years experience. Experience required: Minimum 2 to 6 years of post-qualification experience based on educational qualification. Age limit: Maximum 40 years. Pay: Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 90,000 per month. Qualification required: B.Tech./B.E./M.Sc./M.C.A./LLM./CA/CMA/CS/MBA/Professional qualification; B.C.A./B.Sc./B.A./B.Com./B.B.A./LLB. with 4 years post-qualification experience. Experience required: At least 1 year of experience at a higher education institution, research or academic institution or freelance experience supported by a strong portfolio. Age limit: Maximum 40 years. Pay: Rs. 45,000 to Rs. 80,000 per month.
